'''Mett Habble''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as lesser noble on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Biography==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Habble belonged to a lower nobility and became the leader of the [[Naboo Underground]] during the invasion by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Habble also acted as a secret undercover agent to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] and therefore wore non-military [[Security Guard/Legends|Security Guard]] uniforms.<ref name="PoN" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Habble traveled to Coruscant to escort [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] when she wanted to vote on the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]]. However, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Senator Amidala's [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|J-type diplomatic barge]] exploded during the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|plot to assassinate Senator Amidala]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] was responsible for the assassination attempt.<ref name="FBNF1">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/creating-naming-the-naboos-finest-rogues-gallery-star-wars-insider-145/630688876981223|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=Oct 22, 2013|archivedate=20200412203331}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Habble_rodian_gran.png|thumb|left|150px|Shootout with Rodian and Gran pirates]]
Habble is introduced to the heroes of ''[[Peril on Naboo]]'' in a shootout with [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] and [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] occurring deep in the swamps of Naboo. An image included in the adventure erroneously depicts Mett having the firefight among buildings and paved streets.<ref name="PoN" />
